jeevarasi_events.title: Mangrove Sapling Plantation Drive
jeevarasi_events.description: Join our volunteers and conservation team in restoring the coastal mangrove ecosystem. Saplings, equipment, and refreshments provided.

jeevarasi_events.title: Youth Citizen Scientist Workshop
jeevarasi_events.description: Hands-on experiential workshop for students to explore local bird species, butterfly tagging, and sustainable soil conservation.

jeevarasi_projects.title: Planting 3 Lakhs+ Trees Across Pondicherry
jeevarasi_projects.description: Community-driven mass afforestation initiative restoring indigenous flora and providing sanctuary for birds and pollinators.

jeevarasi_projects.title: Plastic Clean-Up & Wetland Restoration
jeevarasi_projects.description: Over 15 tonnes of plastic waste cleared from coastal waterways in collaboration with university NSS volunteers.

jeevarasi_fundraising.title: Wild Sapling Nursery & Bird Nesting Project
jeevarasi_fundraising.description: Help us expand our native tree sapling nursery and install 500 nesting boxes for breeding sparrows and wild birds.

jeevarasi_blogs.title: Jeevarasi Trust Founded — A New Chapter in Conservation
jeevarasi_blogs.author: Jeevarasi Team
jeevarasi_blogs.summary: Jeevarasi — The Nature School was founded as a Pondicherry-based Trust with a vision to bring people closer to the wild through experiential education and conservation.
jeevarasi_blogs.content_html: Jeevarasi — The Nature School was founded as a Pondicherry-based Trust with a vision to bring people closer to the wild through experiential education and conservation. We focus on creating awareness by educating about the importance of species in their natural habitat.

jeevarasi_blogs.title: Experiential Education at Jeevarasi — Learning by Experience
jeevarasi_blogs.author: Education Team
jeevarasi_blogs.summary: Our experiential teaching approach helps guests understand conservation better through observation, touch, feel, and build experiences — reconnecting them with nature.

jeevarasi_reviews.name: Dr. Priya Ramesh
